scripts.build:ios: if [ -z "${DEVELOPER_DIR:-}" ] && [ ! -d /Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer ]; then echo "Public Xcode.app is required for App Store submission. Install Xcode 26.6+ or use npm run build:ios:cloud."; exit 1; fi; mkdir -p builds && export DEVELOPER_DIR="${DEVELOPER_DIR:-/Applications/Xcode.app/Contents/Developer}" && export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$HOME/.gem/ruby/2.6.0/bin:$PATH" && export RUBYOPT="-rlogger ${RUBYOPT:-}" && NODE_ENV=production npx --yes eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production --local --output ./builds/zenithstudio-v$npm_package_version.ipa
scripts.build:ios:cloud: NODE_ENV=production npx --yes eas-cli build --platform ios --profile production
scripts.build:android: mkdir -p builds && export JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Java/JavaVirtualMachines/temurin-17.jdk/Contents/Home}" && export ANDROID_HOME="${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}" && export ANDROID_SDK_ROOT="$ANDROID_HOME" && export ANDROID_NDK_HOME="${ANDROID_NDK_HOME:-$ANDROID_HOME/ndk/27.1.12297006}" && export PATH="$JAVA_HOME/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/cmdline-tools/latest/bin:$ANDROID_HOME/platform-tools:$PATH" && NODE_ENV=production npx --yes eas-cli build --platform android --profile production --local --output ./builds/zenithstudio-v$npm_package_version.aab
scripts.build:all: npm run build:android && npm run build:ios
